title: Announcements
intro: A platform-wide message shown in the green band above the header and in everyone's notifications. One active announcement at a time keeps it readable.

form.title: New announcement
form.headline: Title
form.headlinePlaceholder: e.g. Thủ Đức Farmers Market opens at 06:00 from October
form.headlineHint: Sentence case, no exclamation marks. Shown in handwriting in the green band.
form.detailPlaceholder: One sentence on what changes for customers or stalls.
form.previewText: And the detail line here, in the green band above the header.
form.windowHint: Leave both dates empty to show it from now on, until you take it down.

list.title: Published and past
list.errorText: Check your connection and try again.

empty.title: No announcements
empty.text: Publish one and every signed-in person sees it as a band above the header.

toast.published: Announcement published. Everyone it is for has it in their notifications.
toast.takenDown: Announcement taken down from the banner. Notifications already sent stay.
toast.takeDownError: Could not take the announcement down.
